rows.name: half_pi

rows.name: four_pi

rows.name: pi_squared

rows.name: zeta_six

rows.name: zeta_eight

rows.name: zeta_ten
rows.route_a: pi^10 / 93555 from chudnovsky

rows.name: zeta_five
rows.route_a: Euler-Maclaurin, head 8192, 201 tail terms, first omitted 6.98e-04 ulp

rows.name: zeta_seven

rows.name: zeta_nine
